caelestia core.caelestia-cli: caelestia cli tool: install, update, themes, wallpapers and so on...

caelestia hyprland.hyprland: wayland compositor and tiling window manager
caelestia hyprland.xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland: screen sharing & screenshots for apps on hyprland
caelestia hyprland.xdg-desktop-portal-gtk: file picker dialogs & other portals hyprland's portal lacks

caelestia qt and gtk.adw-gtk-theme: modern libadwaita look for gtk3 apps
caelestia qt and gtk.qtengine: qt platform theme. Style, icons and fonts for qt apps
caelestia qt and gtk.darkly-bin: modern qt widget style (buttons, menus, scrollbars)
caelestia qt and gtk.frameworkintegration: kde library darkly needs but its PKGBUILD forgets to install
caelestia qt and gtk.papirus-icon-theme: icon theme for gtk and qt apps
caelestia qt and gtk.papirus-folders: recolors papirus folder icons to match the color scheme

caelestia auth.gnome-keyring: stores app passwords & tokens encrypted, unlocked on login
caelestia auth.polkit-gnome: password popup when a gui app needs admin rights

caelestia bluetooth.bluez-utils: bluetoothctl for pairing and connecting from the terminal

caelestia pipewire.pipewire: audio/video server, also powers wayland screen sharing
caelestia pipewire.pipewire-pulse: pulseaudio compatibility, gives most apps their sound
caelestia pipewire.pipewire-audio: audio support for pipewire (incl. bluetooth audio)
caelestia pipewire.pipewire-alsa: routes old alsa apps through pipewire
caelestia pipewire.wireplumber: pipewire session manager: device switching, routing, saved volumes
caelestia pipewire.pwvucontrol: gui volume mixer, per-app volume & device selection

caelestia clipboard.wl-clipboard: copy/paste for wayland, wl-copy & wl-paste cli tools

system.base-devel: meta-package with the core tools for compiling software and building Arch packages (e.g. gcc, make, binutils, fakeroot) and is required for makepkg and the AUR.
system.greetd: lightweight and the best login manager daemon
system.astra-airlock: The greeter for greetd that respects caelestia theme
system.xdg-user-dirs: Tool that manages the default directories in your home folder like Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music

fundamental.firefox: the most well maintained and stable browser that is customizable enough for us
fundamental.tmux: persistent terminal sessions. Everything in your tmux window is owned by a separate process called the tmux server. This process owns your current shell and you are connected to it via the tmux client via a socket file. That assures persistance via ssh for example cuz if your ssh connection drops the remote server is still running the tmux server and everything inside it is still alive and well and you just need to reattach to that session.
fundamental.chezmoi: the most capable and robust dotfiles manager
fundamental.openssh: remote access via ssh and everything connected to it like scp, sftp, ssh-agent, sshd and so on...

gui apps.libreoffice-fresh: word, excel, power point, visio, access and some math formulas
gui apps.localsend: file sending among devices in the LAN. There is mobile app as well

modern cli tools.xh: better curl and httpie, has nice syntax and its for us to use ourselves when we work with some apis in the terminal

utilities.ouch: archive & unarchive primarely for me to use
utilities.wget: http and ftp file downloader, needed by some tools
utilities.curl: general purpose scripting tool speaking http, smtp, ftp and others.
utilities.hyprpicker: extract hex from a color on your screen
utilities.plocate: the fastest version of the locate command, better locate and mlocate
utilities.dosfstools: file system dyagnostics tools like fsck.fat
utilities.trash-cli: tool that implements the official Trash specification. Provides tools to use with the trash like trash-put, trash-list, trash-restore, trash-empty, trash-rm. There are other tools equivalent to trash-cli that are maybe a little better but trash-cli is very mature and very well maintained in the official arch repos.
utilities.ydotool: simulate keyboard or mouse input via a cli tool. Wayland native.

yazi.imagemagick: image previews for less common image formats like avif. It is used in the yazi default config and suggested by the docs to be installed
yazi.sqlite: yazi preview and much more overall nice to have

hacking tools.ffuf: fuzzing tool, better dirb, dirbuster and gobuster

fonts.ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd: coding font + nerd icons (terminal, eza, yazi, prompt)
fonts.noto-fonts: fallback font for most languages, no more □ tofu boxes

virtual machines.virt-manager: a graphical app for creating, starting and managing VMs. It works through libvirt which starts and manages a qemu process for each VM
virtual machines.qemu-desktop: runs the VM and its emulated hardware, it uses KVM (native linux kernel module that kinda turns the linux kernel itself into hypervisor) for acceleration through /dev/kvm
virtual machines.dnsmasq: small, lightweight program that doesis both a DHCP server and a DNS server. We need it for VMs. libvirt uses it but it is an optional dependency

YuBiKey.yubikey-manager: provides ykman the yubikey management cli tool
YuBiKey.yubikey-personalization: adds ykchalresp for testing and installs udev rules so you don’t need root.
YuBiKey.pcsclite: provides pcscd, the smart card daemon.
YuBiKey.libfido2: fido2-token and the related FIDO2 tools
